feeds.title: Australian Vaccination-risks Network Inc.
feeds.description: The AVN was started in 1994 by a group of parents and health professionals who were concerned about the lack of scientifically-based information on the 'other side' of the vaccination issue.

feeds.title: The History of Vaccines
feeds.description: The History of Vaccines explores the role of immunization in the human experience and examines its continuing contributions to public health.

feeds.title: Voices for Vaccines Blog
feeds.description: Voices for Vaccines is a parent-led organization that serves as a catalyst to spark positive parent-to-parent conversations about vaccines and the diseases they prevent by supporting communities, building networks, and developing fact-based content that enables parents to make healthy, informed decisions about vaccination for their children and their communities.

feeds.title: The Vaccine Mom
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Taryn. I am here to educate on vaccines and medical molecular topics such as infectious disease and the immune system without judgment. This is a safe place for the vaccine, molecular medicine, and infectious disease education.

feeds.title: Global News » Vaccines
feeds.description: Globalnews.ca offers Canadians from coast to coast a host of news and information, from breaking news in their community to deep engaging content that puts complex world issues in perspective.

feeds.title: Alliance For Aging Research » Vaccination Health Education
feeds.description: The Alliance for Aging Research is the leading nonprofit organization dedicated to accelerating the pace of scientific discoveries and their application to vastly improve the universal human experience of aging and health. Check out the latest research, stories of vaccinated people and more!

feeds.title: Atlantic Health Partners Blog
feeds.description: Atlantic Health Partners was founded in 2007 with the mission to support healthcare providers in the delivery of immunizations and vaccines. Our blogs cover a wide range of vaccine topics across the healthcare landscape, from aging and immunity to provider recommendations.

feeds.title: Cancer Vaccine Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Cancer Vaccine Institute blog provides information on the latest cancer studies and news, as well as treatments and support. The Cancer Vaccine Institute at the University of Washington Medicine in Seattle, WA, is a group of scientists, doctors, nurses, patients, and philanthropists creating a world where cancer is managed, treated, and ultimately prevented by vaccines.

feeds.title: Shot of Prevention
feeds.description: The Shot of Prevention (SOP) blog is hosted by Vaccinate Your Family: The Next Generation of Every Child By Two (VYF), a national nonprofit organization that aims to raise awareness of the critical importance of vaccinations for people of all ages. In this blog, people come to discuss news and views on vaccines.
